risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Risk Factor 1 as printed: 77%, 84%, 84% and 80% of revenue from operations was derived from the top 10 customers in the six months ended September 30, 2025 and Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023 respectively; any reduction in orders from, or loss of, any major customer could adversely affect the business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
- Pipe fitting accounted for 70.55% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2025 and 72.91% in the six months ended September 30, 2025 (stated in the product-vertical table), tying the business to the building materials / pipes and fittings cycle.
- Land of 1,23,786 sq. ft. purchased and a 1,83,965.67 sq. ft. building under construction, with operations at Units I, II, III and IV to be relocated; the capex is an Object of the Issue and its funding amounts are marked [as being fixed later] in the provided text.
- The DRHP itself flags this: the report was commissioned by and paid for by the Company exclusively for the Issue, and any reliance on such information for making an investment decision is subject to inherent risks (Risk Factor at page 61).
- All seven manufacturing units are in Maharashtra — six in Vasai/Gokhivare/Poman, District Palghar, and one at Kuruli, Taluka Khed, District Pune.
- The Company holds 75.00% of OMG Auto and 73.00% of Infuse HRS; minority holders (Nandakumar Puthiya Veettil 25.00% / 4%, Jawaharlal Maurya 23.00%) hold the balance.
- Manufacturing Units I, III and IV are stated to be rented premises, with Unit-II owned; relocation to fully owned premises is proposed but not yet completed.
- The WONDRA vertical recorded nil revenue in Fiscals 2023-2025 and its first stated contribution, Rs 173.10 lakhs (3.82%), came in the six months ended September 30, 2025; 57 SKUs as of February 28, 2026.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Set up a New Manufacturing Unit at Survey no 14, Hissa No. 3, Poman, Vasai, District Palghar, Maharashtra, on 1,23,786 sq. ft. of purchased land with a 1,83,965.67 sq. ft. building under construction, funded in part from the Net Proceeds.**
- **Consolidate the operations of four existing Company manufacturing units into the New Manufacturing Unit, relocating rented Units-I, III and IV and owned Unit-II to fully owned premises.**
- **Relocation to fully owned premises is expected to improve operational efficiency, reduce production costs and strengthen manufacturing capacity.**
- **Pre-payment / re-payment, in full or in part, of all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the Company, from the Net Proceeds.**
- **Consolidated order book of Rs 9,489.61 Lakhs as of February 28, 2026, to be converted into revenue.**
- **Scale the Cleaning Products vertical under the WONDRA brand (moulds plus finished products such as mops, brushes, scrubbers, wipers and brooms) sold to households and commercial/non-commercial establishments through distributor networks …**
- **Expansion of production capacities alongside the consolidation, stated as part of Object 1 of the Issue.**
- **Enhance visibility and brand image among existing and potential customers and create a public market for the Equity Shares in India through the listing.**
- **The Company, in consultation with the BRLM, may undertake a Pre-IPO Placement prior to filing of the Red Herring Prospectus with the RoC; if undertaken it shall not exceed 20% of the Fresh Issue size and the amount raised will be reduced …**
- **Deploy a portion of the Net Proceeds towards General Corporate Purposes (Object 3).**
